purpose: Evaluate what a follower could realistically capture from POSTED information (zones + management instructions), separately from Farouk's private fills and headline claims. Never an execution signal.
authority: deterministic OHLC matching for all price facts; ai_review fail-closed validator + extended forbidden-token guard for all records

outcome_lanes.1_farouk_fill_outcome: from MT5 position widgets when screenshots exist (descriptive only)
outcome_lanes.2_posted_zone_follower_outcome: limit fills inside the posted zone; achievable-fill capped at zone edges (primary lane when zone posted)
outcome_lanes.3_post_time_follower_outcome: market fill at first bar close after the entry post (zone-less/running calls)
outcome_lanes.4_management_instruction_follower_outcom: lane 2/3 fills + posted instructions applied literally at their timestamps (TP1 partial, sl-to-entry -> scratch modelling, close-worst/hold-best as dimensionless fraction transfers). EXPECTANCY IS COMPUTED ON THIS LANE.
outcome_lanes.5_headline_claim_outcome: claimed pips; reference only; always discounted: claim_discounted_pips = min(claimed, lane2/3 achievable); inflation_ratio = claimed / realised_or_achievable

expectancy_definition: per setup: follower_pips = sum(fraction_i * (exit_i - fill)) over the lane-4 simulation (sign inverted for SHORT); fractions are dimensionless shares of ONE abstract unit (no sizing of any kind); portfolio expectancy = mean/median follower_pips + scratch rate + divergence distribution; descriptive review metrics only
